distribution.summary: Hainan; Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Yunnan; Hong Kong; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Johnson et al. (2020) describes the species from southern China, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Guangxi is retained from directly examined material despite omission from the compact distribution sentence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Three Moraceae hosts are directly supported.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus itinerans Johnson, 2020.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus itinerans
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Cryphalus itinerans Johnson, 2020 was described as new; previously referred to as Hypocryphalus sp.1422.
